name: HR / People Agents
description: Employee lifecycle vocabulary + starter questions (IBM AskHR pattern: employee-facing self-service).
starter_prompts: What is our headcount and attrition rate by department this year?
Summarize open roles and days-to-fill for each
Which compliance trainings are overdue and for whom?

terminology.description: Number of active employees at a point in time.
Rate of voluntary+involuntary departures over a period (annualized).
Days from requisition opening to accepted offer.
Employee Net Promoter Score from pulse surveys.
Employee pay divided by range midpoint — pay-equity lens. Sensitive data: reads are org-admin visible.
Structured first-days/weeks process. Employee PII never leaves the tenant boundary.
